name: @printr/mcp

tools.name: printr_quote
tools.description: Get a cost estimate for creating a token on Printr. Returns itemized costs per chain, total cost in USD and native tokens, and the number of tokens from the initial buy. Use this before printr_create_token to understand costs.

items.description: CAIP-2 chain ID (e.g. 'eip155:8453' for Base, 'solana:5eykt4UsFv8P8NJdTREpY1vzqKqZKvdp' for Solana)

supply_percent.description: Buy a percentage of total supply (0.01–69%)

spend_usd.description: Spend a fixed USD amount (0 for no buy)

spend_native.description: Spend a native token amount (atomic units, '0' for no buy)

tools.name: printr_create_token
tools.description: Create a new token on Printr. Returns an UNSIGNED transaction payload that must be signed by the creator's wallet and submitted on-chain. The payload will be EVM calldata or Solana instructions depending on the home chain. You need separate wallet infrastructure to sign and submit the transaction. Use printr_quote first to estimate costs. Supply image (base64) or image_path (local file path — auto-compressed). If neither is provided and OPENROUTER_API_KEY is set, an image is generated from the token name, symbol, and description. The response includes a token_id (telecoin ID, hex) which can be used to construct the trade page URL: https://app.printr.money/trade/{token_id}. Present this URL to the user after the transaction is confirmed.

creator_accounts.description: One creator address per chain being deployed to

image.description: Base64-encoded image data (max 500KB). JPEG or PNG. Mutually exclusive with image_path.

image_path.description: Absolute path to a local image file. The server reads, auto-compresses if needed, and encodes it. Mutually exclusive with image. If neither image nor image_path is provided and OPENROUTER_API_KEY is configured, an image is generated automatically.

items.description: CAIP-2 chain ID (e.g. 'eip155:8453' for Base, 'solana:5eykt4UsFv8P8NJdTREpY1vzqKqZKvdp' for Solana)

supply_percent.description: Buy a percentage of total supply (0.01–69%)

spend_usd.description: Spend a fixed USD amount (0 for no buy)

spend_native.description: Spend a native token amount (atomic units, '0' for no buy)

external_links.description: Optional external links for the token

tools.name: printr_launch_token
tools.description: Create a token and sign it in one call — collapses printr_create_token + printr_sign_and_submit_evm/svm or printr_open_web_signer into a single round-trip. Supply image (base64) or image_path (auto-compressed). If neither is provided and OPENROUTER_API_KEY is set, an image is auto-generated. With private_key: token is created and submitted on-chain immediately. Without private_key: token is created and a browser signing URL is returned. After submission, present the trade page URL: https://app.printr.money/trade/{token_id}.

creator_accounts.description: One creator address per chain being deployed to. Omit to infer from the signing wallet.

image.description: Base64-encoded image data (max 500KB). JPEG or PNG. Mutually exclusive with image_path.

image_path.description: Absolute path to a local image file. Auto-compressed if needed. Mutually exclusive with image. If neither is provided and OPENROUTER_API_KEY is set, an image is generated automatically.

items.description: CAIP-2 chain ID (e.g. 'eip155:8453' for Base, 'solana:5eykt4UsFv8P8NJdTREpY1vzqKqZKvdp' for Solana)

supply_percent.description: Buy a percentage of total supply (0.01–69%)

spend_usd.description: Spend a fixed USD amount (0 for no buy)

spend_native.description: Spend a native token amount (atomic units, '0' for no buy)

external_links.description: Optional external links for the token

fee_sink.description: Where creator fees are directed. 'dev': creator wallet receives fees (default). 'stake_pool': fees flow to Proof of Belief staking pool, rewarding token holders who stake. 'buyback': fees used to buy back and burn tokens (Solana only). 'liquidity_pool': fees compound into LP, deepening liquidity (Solana only, post-graduation).

custom_fees.description: Custom fee configuration. Omit to use platform defaults.

bonding_curve_dev_fee_bps.description: Custom fee on bonding curve trades in basis points (max 150 bps / 1.5%).

amm_dev_fee_bps.description: Custom fee on AMM trades post-graduation in basis points (max 80 bps / 0.8%).

private_key.description: Private key to sign immediately after token creation. EVM: hex (with or without 0x prefix). SVM: base58 64-byte keypair. WARNING: handle with care — never share or commit this value. If omitted, a browser signing session is started instead.

rpc_url.description: RPC endpoint override. Falls back to RPC_URLS config or chain defaults.

tools.name: printr_get_token
tools.description: Get details about a Printr token by its telecoin ID or CAIP-10 contract address. Returns name, symbol, description, image, creator addresses, deployed chains, bonding curve properties, and external links.

id.description: Telecoin ID (hex, e.g. '0x3a7a8d...') or CAIP-10 address (e.g. 'eip155:8453:0x742d...')

tools.name: printr_get_deployments
tools.description: Check the deployment status of a Printr token across all its target chains. Returns per-chain status (pending, deploying, live, failed), contract addresses, transaction hashes, graduation progress, and cross-chain message details. Use this to monitor a token after creation.

id.description: Telecoin ID (hex, e.g. '0x3a7a8d...') or CAIP-10 address (e.g. 'eip155:8453:0x742d...')

tools.name: printr_sign_and_submit_evm
tools.description: Sign and submit an EVM transaction payload returned by printr_create_token. If no private_key is provided, the user will be prompted to select or provision a wallet. Returns the transaction hash and receipt once confirmed. After successful confirmation, present the trade page URL to the user: https://app.printr.money/trade/{token_id} using the token_id from the prior printr_create_token call.

value.description: Native token value in wei (atomic units)

private_key.description: Hex private key for the creator wallet (with or without 0x prefix). WARNING: handle with care — never share or commit this value. Falls back to EVM_WALLET_PRIVATE_KEY env var or interactive wallet selection.

rpc_url.description: HTTP RPC endpoint for the target chain. Falls back to the chain's default public RPC if omitted.

tools.name: printr_sign_and_submit_svm
tools.description: Sign and submit a Solana transaction payload returned by printr_create_token. If no private_key is provided, the user will be prompted to select or provision a wallet. Returns the transaction signature once confirmed. After successful confirmation, present the trade page URL to the user: https://app.printr.money/trade/{token_id} using the token_id from the prior printr_create_token call.

private_key.description: base58-encoded 64-byte Solana keypair secret. WARNING: handle with care — never share or commit this value. If omitted, the user will be prompted to select or provision a wallet.

tools.name: printr_open_web_signer
tools.description: Starts an ephemeral local signing session and returns a deep link to the Printr web app where the user can sign the transaction using their browser wallet (MetaMask / Phantom). Call this after printr_create_token when the user wants to sign via browser rather than providing a raw private key. Present the returned URL to the user and ask them to open it. After the user confirms they have signed, proceed to poll printr_get_deployments.

chain_type.description: Chain type of the unsigned transaction

payload.description: Full unsigned tx payload returned by printr_create_token

token_meta.description: Token metadata to display in the signing UI. Include name, symbol, description, and current image URL so the user can preview the token and optionally replace its image before signing.

image_url.description: URL of the current token image

rpc_url.description: Optional RPC endpoint override for signing

tools.name: printr_wallet_new
tools.description: Generate a new wallet keypair for the given chain, encrypt it with a password, and save it to the local keystore (~/.printr/wallets.json). Returns the new address and wallet ID. The wallet is immediately set as the active wallet for its chain type. Fund the address with native tokens before signing transactions.

password.description: Password used to encrypt the private key at rest (minimum 12 characters)

tools.name: printr_wallet_import
tools.description: Import an existing private key as the active wallet for its chain. Optionally encrypt and save it to the local keystore by providing a label and password. The wallet is set active immediately.

private_key.description: Raw private key — EVM: hex (with or without 0x), SVM: base58 64-byte keypair

label.description: Label for saving to keystore (required together with password)

password.description: Password to encrypt and save to keystore (minimum 12 characters)

tools.name: printr_wallet_list
tools.description: List wallets saved in the local keystore (~/.printr/wallets.json). Private keys are never returned.

tools.name: printr_wallet_unlock
tools.description: Decrypt a stored keystore wallet with its password and set it as the active wallet for its chain type. Once unlocked, signing tools use it automatically for the rest of the session (until the MCP server restarts).

tools.name: printr_wallet_remove
tools.description: Remove a wallet from the local keystore. Does not affect the active wallet for the current session.

tools.name: printr_wallet_bulk_remove
tools.description: Remove multiple wallets from the local keystore at once. Does not affect active wallets for the current session.

wallet_ids.description: List of keystore wallet IDs to remove

tools.name: printr_set_treasury_wallet
tools.description: Set a keystore wallet as the treasury wallet for funding deployment wallets. Once set, printr_fund_deployment_wallet and printr_drain_deployment_wallet will use this wallet instead of requiring environment variables. The treasury wallet persists for the session (until the MCP server restarts). Use printr_wallet_new or printr_wallet_import to add wallets first.

wallet_id.description: Keystore wallet ID to use as treasury — from printr_wallet_list

tools.name: printr_get_balance
tools.description: Get the native token balance of a wallet address. Supports EVM chains (ETH, BNB, AVAX, etc.) and Solana. Use this to check if a wallet has sufficient funds before creating or trading tokens.

account.description: CAIP-10 account address (e.g. 'eip155:8453:0x742d...' for Base, 'solana:5eykt4UsFv8P8NJdTREpY1vzqKqZKvdp:7S3P4H...' for Solana)

tools.name: printr_get_token_balance
tools.description: Get the balance of an ERC-20 or SPL token for a wallet address. Use this to check token holdings before trading or transferring.

wallet.description: CAIP-10 wallet address to check balance for (must be on the same chain as token)

tools.name: printr_transfer
tools.description: Transfer native tokens (ETH, SOL, BNB, etc.) to another address. Uses the active wallet from printr_wallet_unlock if no private_key is provided.

amount.description: Amount to send in human-readable units (e.g. '0.1' for 0.1 ETH or SOL)

private_key.description: Private key to sign the transaction. EVM: hex (with or without 0x). SVM: base58 keypair. If omitted, uses the active wallet from printr_wallet_unlock.

tools.name: printr_transfer_token
tools.description: Transfer fungible tokens (ERC20 on EVM chains, SPL tokens on Solana) to another address. Auto-detects token decimals and creates the recipient's SPL associated token account if missing. Uses the active wallet from printr_wallet_unlock if no private_key is provided.

to.description: CAIP-10 recipient address (e.g. 'eip155:8453:0x...' or 'solana:5eykt...:pubkey'). On Solana this MUST be the recipient's owner wallet, not an associated token account — the ATA is derived automatically.

token.description: CAIP-10 token ID (e.g. 'eip155:8453:0xtoken...' or 'solana:5eykt...:mintAddress'). Must be on the same chain as the recipient. Decimals are auto-detected from the token contract / mint.

amount.description: Amount to send in human-readable units (e.g. '1.5' for 1.5 USDC)

private_key.description: Private key to sign the transaction. EVM: hex (with or without 0x). SVM: base58 keypair. If omitted, uses the active wallet from printr_wallet_unlock.

tools.name: printr_fund_deployment_wallet
tools.description: Create a fresh deployment wallet and fund it from the treasury wallet. Uses the SVM_WALLET_PRIVATE_KEY or EVM_WALLET_PRIVATE_KEY environment variable as the funding source. The new wallet is set as the active wallet for signing. Use this before printr_launch_token to deploy tokens without exposing the treasury. Requires PRINTR_DEPLOYMENT_PASSWORD to be set for wallet encryption.

chain.description: CAIP-2 chain ID (e.g. 'solana:5eykt4UsFv8P8NJdTREpY1vzqKqZKvdp' for Solana mainnet)

amount.description: Amount to fund in human-readable units (e.g. '0.6' for 0.6 SOL)

tools.name: printr_drain_deployment_wallet
tools.description: Drain remaining funds from a deployment wallet back to the treasury. NOTE: drain runs automatically inside printr_launch_token — only call this tool manually to recover a stuck wallet (e.g. after a crash or if printr_launch_token was not called). Automatically calculates gas fees and drains the maximum possible amount. Can recover wallets after MCP restart using persisted state and PRINTR_DEPLOYMENT_PASSWORD.

chain.description: CAIP-2 chain ID (e.g. 'solana:5eykt4UsFv8P8NJdTREpY1vzqKqZKvdp' for Solana mainnet)

keep_minimum.description: Minimum amount to keep in the wallet (default: 0, drain everything possible)

wallet_id.description: Keystore wallet ID to drain. If not provided, uses the active deployment wallet (from memory or recovered from persisted state after restart).

tools.name: printr_supported_chains
tools.description: List all blockchain networks supported by Printr MCP. Returns chain IDs, names, native token info, and RPC availability.

tools.name: printr_get_creator_fees
tools.description: Check accumulated creator fees for a token across all deployed chains. Returns fee amounts and whether they can be claimed. Use printr_claim_fees to claim the fees to the treasury.

token_id.description: Telecoin ID (hex) or CAIP-10 token address

chains.description: Optional: subset of CAIP-2 chain IDs to query. If empty, queries all chains.

tools.name: printr_claim_fees
tools.description: Claim accumulated creator fees for a token on a specific chain. First use printr_get_creator_fees to check available fees, then call this to claim. Uses the treasury wallet to sign and submit the claim transaction. Returns the transaction hash/signature on success.

token_id.description: Telecoin ID (hex) or CAIP-10 token address

chain.description: CAIP-2 chain ID to claim fees on (e.g., 'solana:5eykt4UsFv8P8NJdTREpY1vzqKqZKvdp')

tools.name: printr_get_staking_positions
tools.description: Get staking positions with claimable rewards. Returns positions for the treasury wallet by default, or for a specific owner if provided. Shows claimable and historically claimed quote/telecoin rewards for each position. Use printr_claim_staking_rewards to claim rewards (or withdraw unlocked principal) from a position.

token_id.description: Telecoin ID (hex) to filter positions by. Optional.

owner.description: CAIP-10 owner address to filter positions by. If omitted, uses treasury wallet addresses.

limit.description: Maximum number of positions to return (default: 50).

tools.name: printr_claim_staking_rewards
tools.description: Claim staking rewards from a specific stake position. If the position is already unlocked, this also withdraws the staked principal. First use printr_get_staking_positions to find positions with claimable rewards or that are unlocked. Uses the treasury wallet to sign and submit the transaction. Returns the transaction hash/signature on success.

position.description: CAIP-10 address of the stake position to claim rewards from

creation_tx.description: Transaction ID that created this stake position

tools.name: printr_create_stake_position
tools.description: Create a new stake position for a telecoin. Specify the telecoin id, the asset/amount to stake, and the lock period. Uses the treasury wallet (on the asset's chain) as the payer and position owner, then signs and submits the returned transaction on-chain. Currently only Solana telecoins can be staked. Returns the transaction hash/signature on success.

asset.description: CAIP-10 address of the asset to stake (typically the telecoin mint)

atomic.description: Amount to stake in the asset's smallest unit (atomic)

decimals.description: Decimals of the asset being staked

lock_period.description: Lock period for the stake position (currently Solana-only)
